gates.title: Native smoke

phases.a: stock Windows data in the Unity Mac player: build-target acceptance, scripts reach the main menu (pink expected), shader error lines, DllNotFound list, EOS-absent behaviour, HarmonyX arm64 (with --bepinex-zip)
phases.b: same player with PEAK shaders converted ON THIS MAC by native/pm.py (loose Data files, no data.unity3d): main menu + Airport screenshots; y-orientation, depth, sRGB, framebuffer fetch (CoreCopy), instancing, missing materials. Needs python3 >= 3.11 + UnityPy + lz4 + spirv-cross: detected, never installed (phase b is skipped and reported when absent)

gates.pass: phase a: no build-target error and >= 2 of 3 main-menu log markers; phase b (when the converter is available): converter exit 0, no build-target error, main-menu markers, renders without crash/black screen. Everything else is recorded for Track C.
gates.notes: Phase (a): stock Windows data in Unity's Mac player (pink expected): build-target acceptance, scripts reach main menu, DllNotFound list, EOS-missing behaviour (observe only, never stub), HarmonyX arm64. Phase (b): shaders converted ON the iMac from the job's own depot with the bundle; loose Data files first (no data.unity3d), archive as second variant. Nothing converted is copied back except screenshots, logs and the converter's JSON report.
